dedupeText: crystalline cinematic title card crystalline hextech vignette glowing text organic frame blue gradient centralized hierarchy with the primary title as the focal point contrast between sharp hard edged crystalline text and soft radial light framing effect created by organic out of focus foreground elements monochromatic blue to black color transition emphasizing depth combine 3d crystalline typography radial blue glow organic perforated frame to create a cinematic entertainment aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-contrast cinematic layout featuring 3D crystalline typography framed by organic, perforated silhouettes against a deep blue radial glow.
excludeWhen: bright or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central glowing title in a glass-like 3D texture, anchored by a secondary subtitle, all contained within a dark vignette and framed by white, web-like organic structures with irregular circular cutouts.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized hierarchy with the primary title as the focal point
Contrast between sharp, hard-edged crystalline text and soft radial light
Framing effect created by organic, out-of-focus foreground elements
Monochromatic blue-to-black color transition emphasizing depth
coreInvariants: Radial blue glow centered behind the primary text
Organic, perforated white framing elements in the corners
3D beveled text with internal crystalline refraction patterns

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary title is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, lens-flare-like glow emanating from the center of the primary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central glowing title, move down to the subtitle, then outward to the organic framing elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue and black negative space creates a sense of vastness and focuses attention on the center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Navy and Cobalt Blue (Background and Atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Cyan and White (Glow and Highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the center fading to low value/high saturation at the edges.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blues, blacks, and whites to maintain a cold, magical atmosphere.

letterConstructionRules: Internal textures mimicking cracked ice or crystal
High-contrast specular highlights on the top edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a high crossbar and sharp apex
The 'E' has equal-length horizontal strokes with sharp terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy 3D display type with a clean, thin, condensed sans-serif for metadata to provide scale and clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary monumental and modern feel.
Matches the tech-magic aesthetic of the source.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep blue radial gradient background with a bright cyan center. Add out-of-focus, white, organic web-like structures with circular holes in the corners to frame the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Render the primary title in a 3D crystalline glass style with internal refractions and a central lens flare. Add secondary text in a clean, white, condensed sans-serif below.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text centered and glowing?
Are the corner frames organic and perforated?
Is the color palette strictly blue, black, and white?
Does the text have a 3D beveled appearance?

adjustableVariables: Density of the perforations in the framing elements
mustRedesign: Exact character spacing of the original brand

mustAchieve: Sense of depth through 3D text and vignetting

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in the main title
Verify the radial gradient is centered
Ensure the framing elements are out of focus
Confirm the text is legible against the glow
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [3D Crystalline Typography] + [Radial Blue Glow] + [Organic Perforated Frame] to create a cinematic entertainment aesthetic.
